    """Collapse each compartment to a marker when it contains multiple accents."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separator rows/columns are solid lines distinct from the panel background.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Keep only solid lines that are not the dominant panel background.
    # In these ARC grids the separators are the remaining all-solid color lines.
    # Determine panels by runs between separator lines.
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_cuts[i] + 1, row_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_cuts) - 1) if row_cuts[i + 1] > row_cuts[i] + 1]
    col_spans = [(col_cuts[i] + 1, col_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_cuts) - 1) if col_cuts[i + 1] > col_cuts[i] + 1]
    # Main background is the most frequent non-divider color.
    divider = set(grid[sep_rows[0]]) if sep_rows else set()
    # Separator rows/cols share a common color; count all non-line cells.
    line_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
